objective.text: Choose allowFailures when one failed job must not automatically cancel unrelated batch work.

difficulty.rationale: Allow unrelated work to continue while retaining accurate failure records.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A batch imports independent tenant files. One bad file should be recorded as failed without automatically cancelling the remaining imports. Which batch option expresses that policy?

options.rationale: This prevents automatic batch cancellation on a job failure while preserving the failure count.

options.text: cancel() before dispatching the remaining work
options.rationale: Cancellation is the opposite of allowing the independent work to continue.
options.misconception: Cancellation is the opposite of allowing the independent work to continue.

options.rationale: A queue name does not alter how the batch reacts to a failed job.
options.misconception: A queue name does not alter how the batch reacts to a failed job.

options.rationale: An all-success callback does not change the batch’s failure-cancellation policy.
options.misconception: An all-success callback does not change the batch’s failure-cancellation policy.
